title: Facebook Leads auto-syncing into ERPNext CRM — this feature is a game changer

posts.name: Satat Tech
posts.cooked:
Hey, everyone,

One thing we genuinely love about ERPNext is how it keeps surprising us with features that make us proud to be part of this ecosystem. This one deserves more attention than it gets.

ERPNext CRM has a built-in Lead Syncing feature, and yes, Facebook is a supported source. Leads from your Facebook Lead can automatically land inside your CRM.

It’s been out for a while, but honestly, not enough people are talking about it. This kind of feature is setting the bar for what an open-source ERP should be capable of. Other ERP systems charge a premium for this kind of connectivity, but ERPNext get it built in. That’s something worth celebrating.

Attaching a screenshot of the UI for those who haven’t come across it yet. Clean, simple, and right inside CRM settings where it belongs.

Has anyone in the community already rolled this out for their clients? Would love to hear real-world experiences, how it’s performing, what kind of volumes it handles well, and whether your clients found it impactful.
